title: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat answers from open tabs and YouTube videos
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing, regional defaults and documented controls are supported. The impact rationale should qualify its statement about access for every user to acknowledge existing user choices.

claims.claim: Copilot Chat in the Edge side pane can answer about open browser tabs and YouTube videos.
claims.quote: Get relevant answers and insights about your open browser tabs and YouTube videos directly from the Edge side pane

claims.claim: Multi-tab grounding extends an existing capability limited to the open page.
claims.quote: This extends the existing capability which can only access the open page.

claims.claim: Version 146.0.3856.72 release notes dated March 20, 2026 announce forthcoming open-window contextual questions.
claims.quote: Version 146.0.3856.72: March 20, 2026 (Stable) ... Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge will soon be able to answer contextual questions about a user's open window.

claims.claim: No meter or price specific to multi-tab or YouTube grounding is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Edge multi tab YouTube separate license price meter. Read Copilot overview, Edge release notes and pay-as-you-go meters search excerpts; published meters concern agents, not this grounding capability.

claims.claim: Nothing license-specific to multi-tab or YouTube grounding is published beyond the general Copilot Chat entitlement.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Edge multiple tabs YouTube grounding license pricing limits single page policy; Copilot Chat Edge multi tab YouTube separate license price meter. Read Copilot overview, Edge policy references and release notes; no separate feature entitlement found.

claims.claim: The cloud setting is in Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Edge > Copilot > Access to browser context.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft Edge management service, select the Copilot tab ... Access to browser context: Allows Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to use a user’s browser context, such as page content, to provide contextual responses.

claims.claim: No separate automation operation is documented for setting Access to browser context in the Edge management service.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge management service Access to browser context EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext API Microsoft Graph configuration policy; Graph Edge management configuration beta. Opened Edge API overview and browser-edge-concept-overview; these document IE site lists, not this cloud setting.

claims.claim: Edge management service configuration policies can be assigned to groups.
claims.quote: Each configuration policy can be assigned to multiple Microsoft Entra groups, and a group can be assigned to multiple configuration policies.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Edge management service is not available to customers with GCC plans.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Edge management service is currently not available to customers with GCC plans.

claims.claim: Device GPO or MDM policy overrides conflicting Edge management service policy by default.
claims.quote: Any policies you apply with Microsoft Edge management service will be overridden if they conflict with an existing Group Policy Object (GPO) or Mobile Device Management (MDM) policy that's set on the device.

claims.claim: EdgeManagementPolicyOverridesPlatformPolicy can reverse the default policy-source precedence.
claims.quote: If you want the Microsoft Edge management service policy to override MDM/GPM policy you can set the override in the EdgeManagementPolicyOverridesPlatformPolicy policy.

claims.claim: The toolbar policy is under Computer Configuration or User Configuration > Policies > Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge with the printed toolbar label.
claims.quote: GP name: Control whether Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat shows in the Microsoft Edge for Business toolbar ... GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge

claims.claim: Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled controls toolbar-icon visibility for Entra profiles using the side pane.
claims.quote: For users in an Entra ID Microsoft Edge profile, this policy controls whether the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon is shown ... This policy only applies when users are accessing Copilot in the sidepane.

claims.claim: The toolbar-icon policy supports Windows and macOS from version 139.
claims.quote: Windows: ≥ 139 ... macOS: ≥ 139

claims.claim: The toolbar-icon policy page does not describe that policy as controlling page-content access.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled page-content access, by reading its complete policy reference. It describes toolbar visibility, not page-content access; EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext separately documents the latter.

claims.claim: The default state is on, with the body qualifying this as the non-EU unconfigured default.
claims.quote: If you don't configure this policy: ... Access is enabled by default in non-EU regions. ... Access is disabled by default in EU regions.

claims.claim: The direct-cost rating is none because the described Copilot Chat experience is included with eligible existing licenses.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat (Basic) is the standalone baseline experience included with eligible Microsoft 365 licenses. ... Copilot Chat in Edge

claims.claim: The grounding change describes contextual reading initiated by the user, not a new action taken on pages.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Edge contextual grounding multi tabs actions pages user settings consent. Read the page-context policy and the relevant Stable release-note entries: they describe user-initiated contextual queries, answers and summaries, not page actions for this change.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The page-context policy reference says DLP-protected pages cannot be read even when the policy is enabled.
claims.quote: Copilot can't access page content on pages protected by data loss prevention (DLP) policies, even if this policy is enabled.

claims.claim: Every Entra-signed-in Edge for Business user outside the EU gets page-content access by default.
claims.quote: If you don't configure this policy: ... Access is enabled by default in non-EU regions. ... Users can turn this setting on or off in Microsoft Edge settings.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with 'High. Page-content access is enabled by default outside the EU when the policy is unconfigured, while existing user settings continue to be respected.' In Why it matters, replace 'Outside the EU this works on arrival unless the page-context policy has been set' with 'Outside the EU access is enabled by default when the page-context policy is unconfigured, while existing user settings continue to be respected.' The existing cited Stable release notes explicitly preserve existing user settings.

claims.claim: Administrators can open edge://policy on a client device to check applied policy values.
claims.quote: On a target client device, open Microsoft Edge and go to edge://policy to see all policies that are applied.

claims.claim: When enabled, the policy permits content, history and transcript access when users initiate contextual queries in the side pane or from Edge.
claims.quote: If you enable this policy, Copilot can access page content, browsing history, and video transcript when users initiate contextual queries in the side pane or from Edge.
